description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveAllocateEmailProcessor class, responsible for processing email notifications related to leave allocation events within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It implements methods to generate email content replacements and determine recipients for leave allocation emails.

classes.name: LeaveAllocateEmailProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes email notifications related to leave allocation events, generating email content and determining recipients based on leave allocation data.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Generates a set of placeholder replacements for email templates based on leave allocation event data.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Determines the list of email recipients for leave allocation notification based on recipient role.
